steps.title: Start with a piece and 4 legs
steps.instruction: Join a piece and 4 legs (A, B, C, D, E), as the animation shows. Page 11 of the IKEA manual shows this step.
checklist: A piece and 4 legs are joined

faq.answer: This guide doesn’t show fittings for the VESKEN shelf unit. Page 11 of the paper manual shows which ones to use and how many.
The blue parts: A (piece, about 43 cm), B (leg, about 38 cm), C (leg, about 38 cm), D (leg, about 38 cm), E (leg, about 38 cm). Watch where they go in the animation.
Sizes are approximate: this model has no real measurements, so it is shown about 120 cm tall.
